POSTAL RUN · An original postal-themed card game prototype · No connection to or endorsement by USPS

Welcome to Postal Run

Race your postal route to 1,000 miles. Dispatch your truck, deliver mail, and use postal mishaps to slow the computer courier. Draw one card and play one card each turn.

First to 1,000 miles wins the round. Your route must be dispatched before you can deliver.
